note: Masses are catalogue estimates; weigh every part. Prices are indicative USD. Propulsion: coaxial contra-rotating brushless pair on a servo gimbal, see docs/design-choices.md.

items.name: Carbon-fibre rods, 6 mm x 450 mm
items.spec: Solid or thick-wall tube, 6 mm dia
items.notes: Cut to 425 mm, deburr, seal ends with CA.

items.name: Stack plates (battery, PCB, telemetry)
items.notes: Print flat, 4 perimeters, 40% gyroid.

items.name: Landing frame (diamond plate with four hinge lugs)
items.notes: 133 mm diamond, corners on the leg axes

items.name: Landing legs 8 mm x 300 mm + rubber feet
items.spec: Carbon or aluminium tube, hinged at the corner lugs
items.notes: 34 deg from vertical, footprint 510 mm

items.name: Leg braces (1.6 mm steel or CF rod)
items.spec: From gimbal mount to leg mid-point

items.name: Gimbal printed parts (mount, outer ring, collar)
items.notes: Collar grips the 42 mm motor-mount tube.

items.name: Gear sector 36T + pinion 18T, module 1 (set)
items.spec: Acetal, nylon or printed PA; CAD names gear36t1 / gear36t2
items.notes: 2:1 reduction: servo travel = 2x gimbal travel.

items.name: Digital metal-gear servo, 20 g class, HV
items.notes: Buy a spare.

items.name: Pivot pins M3 x 60 + 683ZZ bearings
items.notes: Zero play is a requirement: shim until backlash < 0.3 deg.

items.name: Service-loop cable for servo 2
items.notes: Servo 2 rides on the outer ring.

items.name: Brushless motor 3110, about 900 KV (coaxial pair)
items.spec: 6S rated, 5 mm shaft, prop adapters for CW and CCW
items.notes: Static thrust about 1.5 kgf each with a 9 in prop on 6S (vendor data: measure it on the stand).

items.name: Propellers 9x4.5, one CW and one CCW
items.notes: Contra-rotating pair: reaction torques cancel.

items.name: Spare propellers 9x4.5 (2 CW + 2 CCW)
items.notes: The first crash breaks one.

items.name: ESC 40 A, 6S, 400 Hz PWM (BLHeli_S / AM32)
items.notes: Set the directions in the configurator before the first spin.

items.name: Motor mount: Ø42 carbon tube, cage struts, guard ring
items.spec: Carbon tube 58 mm + printed plates, 3 struts and a Ø246 mm guard ring
items.notes: Holds motor A above the props and motor B below.

items.name: Power distribution board + 1000 uF 35 V capacitors + XT60
items.spec: Two ESC feeds, capacitor close to each ESC

items.name: LiPo 6S 1500 mAh, 75C+, XT60 (main pack)
items.notes: Feeds the ESCs and, through BECs, the servos.

items.name: LiPo 2S 450 mAh (avionics pack)
items.notes: Keeps the flight computer and log alive and electrically isolated from ESC noise.

items.name: Servo BEC 7.4 V / 5 A (from the 6S pack)
items.notes: Servos are HV rated.

items.name: 5 V / 3 A regulator (logic, from the 2S pack)
Fuse 5 A (servo BEC) + remove-before-flight pin + arm switch
items.spec: RBF pin breaks the main-pack supply: removable with gloves

items.name: Wiring harness, connectors, heat shrink
items.spec: 12-14 AWG motor and power leads, 26-28 AWG signals, locking connectors
items.notes: No bare Dupont connectors on a rocket: vibration.

items.name: IMU ICM-42688-P
items.notes: Mount near the stack axis.

items.name: Barometer BMP390
items.notes: Vent the frame; avoid sealed cavities.

items.name: ExpressLRS 2.4 GHz receiver + antenna
items.spec: CRSF over UART, link statistics on the radio
items.notes: Antenna on the top plate, clear of the carbon rods.

items.name: GPS u-blox M10 module
items.notes: Top plate, antenna clear of carbon rods.

items.name: microSD card
items.notes: Logs are how you tune.

items.name: Test stand: base, column, 20 kg load cell + HX711
items.notes: See docs/phase2-rocket/07-test-stand-procedure.md

items.name: Prop shield: polycarbonate panel or net cage
items.notes: Props shed fragments.

items.name: Current-limited bench supply or smoke stopper
items.spec: Limit to 2-3 A for the first power-up

items.name: ELRS transmitter / radio
items.spec: Any EdgeTX radio with an ELRS module
items.notes: Skip if you already own one.

items.name: Balance charger + LiPo safe bag (6S capable)
Tether kit: 3 x 3 m line, anchors, swivel
Fire extinguisher, gloves, eye protection
items.notes: Required at every powered test.
